# Squeeze — In-Browser Image Conversion & Compression Engine

> Squeeze is a free, 100% client-side web utility that converts and compresses JPG, PNG, WebP, ICO, and SVG images directly in modern web browsers. Zero bytes are uploaded to remote servers. All computation executes locally on device hardware using HTML5 Canvas, OffscreenCanvas, and multi-threaded Web Workers.

Website: https://www.trysqueeze.online
License: MIT
Pricing: 100% Free ($0)
Platform: Modern Web Browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

## Core Tools
- [Image Converter & Compressor](https://www.trysqueeze.online/): Universal multi-format tool supporting batch queue, perceptual SSIM quality tuning, and single-click ZIP archive packaging.
- [PNG to WebP Converter](https://www.trysqueeze.online/convert/png-to-webp): Converts transparent PNG graphics into next-generation Google WebP format with 25% to 40% byte reduction while preserving alpha channels.
- [PNG to ICO Favicon Generator](https://www.trysqueeze.online/convert/png-to-ico): Encodes true 32-bit RGBA multi-resolution Windows ICO container files containing 16x16, 32x32, 48x48, 64x64, 128x128, and 256x256 frames.
- [JPG to PNG Converter](https://www.trysqueeze.online/convert/jpg-to-png): Re-encodes JPEG images to lossless PNG format to stop generation loss during editing.
- [PNG to JPG Converter](https://www.trysqueeze.online/convert/png-to-jpg): Converts transparent or heavy PNG files to optimized JPEG with configurable background matte filling.
- [SVG to PNG Converter](https://www.trysqueeze.online/convert/svg-to-png): Rasterizes scalable vector graphics into crisp, high-DPI transparent PNG assets.
- [PNG to SVG Vectorizer](https://www.trysqueeze.online/convert/png-to-svg): Traces raster bitmap silhouettes into scalable vector SVG paths using client-side marching squares.
- [Compress JPG](https://www.trysqueeze.online/compress/jpg): Reduces JPEG byte weight via perceptual SSIM (Structural Similarity Index Measure) quality protection.
- [Compress PNG](https://www.trysqueeze.online/compress/png): Optimizes PNG image weight without introducing edge distortion or color banding.
- [Compress WebP](https://www.trysqueeze.online/compress/webp): Maximizes WebP compression for high-performance Core Web Vitals and LCP speed.
- [Developer Hub & API Sandbox](https://www.trysqueeze.online/developers): Programmatic Web Worker SDK, Headless Cloud REST API, interactive in-browser request tester, multi-language code snippets (cURL, TS, Python, Go, Rust), and instant sandbox keys.

## Educational Guides & Format Engineering
- [What is PNG?](https://www.trysqueeze.online/learn/what-is-png): Anatomy, chunks (IHDR/IDAT), 8-bit alpha transparency, and Deflate LZ77 compression math.
- [What is JPEG / JPG?](https://www.trysqueeze.online/learn/what-is-jpeg): RGB to YCbCr conversion, 4:2:0 chroma subsampling, DCT frequency quantization, and lossy artifacts.
- [What is WebP?](https://www.trysqueeze.online/learn/what-is-webp): Google's VP8-derived next-gen format with lossy alpha transparency and 30% byte savings.
- [What is SVG?](https://www.trysqueeze.online/learn/what-is-svg): XML vector geometry, infinite scalability, marching squares raster-to-vector tracing, and sanitization.
- [What is ICO?](https://www.trysqueeze.online/learn/what-is-ico): Multi-resolution Windows binary packaging (16px to 256px) for production web favicons.
- [Why Platforms Require Specific Formats](https://www.trysqueeze.online/learn/why-platforms-require-specific-formats): Technical analysis of decompression bombs, transcoding latency, and CDN costs.
- [E-Commerce Image Requirements (Shopify & Amazon)](https://www.trysqueeze.online/learn/ecommerce-image-formats-shopify-amazon): Page speed conversion rates, zoom requirements, and catalog optimization.
- [Why WordPress Restricts SVG](https://www.trysqueeze.online/learn/why-wordpress-restricts-svg): XML Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), entity injection (XXE), and safe vector solutions.
- [Why Browsers Require Favicon.ico](https://www.trysqueeze.online/learn/why-browsers-require-ico-favicons): How Googlebot and browser tabs index root favicons and avoid downscaling blur.
- [Why Social Media Compresses Images](https://www.trysqueeze.online/learn/why-social-media-compresses-images): Discord, Slack, and X compression thresholds and pre-optimization tactics.
- [Lossless vs. Lossy Compression](https://www.trysqueeze.online/learn/lossless-vs-lossy-compression): Mathematical exactness vs. perceptual approximation, HVS biology, and generation loss.
- [What is SSIM?](https://www.trysqueeze.online/learn/what-is-ssim-image-quality): Structural Similarity Index Measure (luminance, contrast, structure) vs. PSNR/MSE.
- [Raster vs. Vector Graphics](https://www.trysqueeze.online/learn/raster-vs-vector-graphics): Color matrices vs. Bézier geometry, complexity explosions, and tracing algorithms.
- [Transparency & JPG Black Backgrounds](https://www.trysqueeze.online/learn/transparency-alpha-channels-and-jpg-matte): 32-bit RGBA alpha channel math and automated matte compositing.
- [EXIF Metadata Privacy Risks](https://www.trysqueeze.online/learn/exif-metadata-privacy-risks): GPS tags, device fingerprints, and how in-browser canvas sanitizes photos.
- [Core Web Vitals & LCP Image Optimization](https://www.trysqueeze.online/learn/image-optimization-for-core-web-vitals-lcp): How WebP reduces Largest Contentful Paint for higher Google rankings.
- [How In-Browser Image Processing Works](https://www.trysqueeze.online/learn/how-in-browser-image-conversion-works): OffscreenCanvas, createImageBitmap, and multi-threaded Web Workers.
- [Client-Side vs. Cloud Converters](https://www.trysqueeze.online/learn/client-side-vs-cloud-image-converters): Zero-upload architecture, data retention hazards, and enterprise compliance.
- [Responsive Image Delivery (<picture> & srcset)](https://www.trysqueeze.online/learn/responsive-images-picture-tag-and-webp): HTML format negotiation, WebP sources, and legacy fallbacks.
- [Retina & High-DPI Image Optimization](https://www.trysqueeze.online/learn/retina-high-dpi-image-optimization): Compressive images trick: 2x resolution at 75% quality for crisp, light graphics.
- [How to Integrate Client-Side Image Processing](https://www.trysqueeze.online/learn/how-to-integrate-client-side-image-processing-api): Step-by-step developer guide to Web Workers, OffscreenCanvas, and Transferable Objects in React/Vue/Next.js.
- [Building Zero-Upload Image Architectures](https://www.trysqueeze.online/learn/building-zero-upload-image-pipelines): Privacy-preserving frontend engineering, GDPR/HIPAA compliance, and DevTools zero-egress auditing.
- [Automated Batch Image Processing with REST APIs & Webhooks](https://www.trysqueeze.online/learn/automating-image-optimization-with-webhooks-and-rest-api): Headless API automation, rate-limit headers (X-RateLimit-*), HMAC-SHA256 signatures, and CI/CD quality gates.

## Technical Specifications & Capabilities
- Processing Environment: Client-Side Browser Memory (No remote upload)
- Concurrency: Multi-threaded Web Worker pool (scales up to hardwareConcurrency)
- Maximum File Size: Device memory bound (tested up to 50MB per file)
- Privacy Standard: Zero data transmission; no telemetry of user image bytes
- Batch Processing: Unlimited concurrent files with client-side JSZip packaging
- Perceptual Quality Metric: SSIM (Structural Similarity Index Measure)
